# Menahem — Luxury Curated Home Essentials
> "The one that comforts you"

Menahem is a premium Indian home essentials and decor brand curating elegant curtains, luxury combed cotton towels, artisanal linen tablecloths, decorative cushion covers, and high-thread-count bedsheets designed for comfort, beauty, and timeless living.

## Key Pages & Navigation
- [Home & Hero Showcase](https://menahem.in/): Transform your home with timeless elegance.
- [Shop by Category](https://menahem.in/#shop-categories): Curtains, Towels, Table Linen, Cushion Covers, Bedsheets, Rugs & Carpets, Home Accessories, Kitchen Linen.
- [Trending Home Essentials](https://menahem.in/#trending): Featured top-rated essentials including Blackout Curtains, Bath Towels, and Tablecloths.
- [Why Choose Menahem](https://menahem.in/#why-us): Customer satisfaction, premium quality materials, easy returns, and secure checkout.

## Key Facts & Value Propositions
- **Primary Brand Promise:** High-quality, durable, tactile home textiles that bring lasting calm and elegance.
- **Shipping & Delivery:** Free shipping across India on orders over ₹999.
- **Customer Support:** Direct personal styling and order assistance via WhatsApp.
- **Payment Options:** 100% secure checkout supporting UPI, Credit/Debit cards, Netbanking, and Pay on Delivery.
